# PROCESS — what I did this iteration (explainability; REQUIRED)

## Summary decision: NO capability edit shipped — 100% infra-blocked run

All 50/50 val rollouts fail with the **identical** error at the API request layer,
before the model ever processes the prompt:

```
litellm.BadRequestError 400: Unsupported value: 'temperature' does not support 0.0
with this model. Only the default (1) value is supported. Model Group=azure/gpt-5.5
```

Evidence (checked programmatically across all 50 trajectory files):
- 50/50 distinct error signatures collapse to this one 400.
- 0/50 have any `tool_calls`; 0/50 have `tokens>0`; all have `output: null`, `trace: null`.
- The model NEVER consumed the system prompt — the request is rejected on the
  `temperature` parameter, which is independent of prompt content.

The only editable artifact is `prompt.md` (system-prompt capability). Nothing in a
system prompt sets or influences the `temperature` request parameter — that is set by
the harness LLM client. Therefore **no prompt edit can change any rollout's outcome**:
it fails the VERIFIED test by construction (the failure is independent of prompt text),
and a re-score under the unchanged config would again be 0.000 → the gate rejects it as
net-zero. Shipping a speculative prompt edit here is exactly the "padding with
speculative/cosmetic edits" the instructions forbid.

## Ranked issue list
| rank | cluster | tasks | shared root cause | tag | planned change class |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | temperature=0.0 rejected by azure/gpt-5.5 | ALL 50 | harness sends `temperature:0.0`; model only allows default(1) | INFRA (not KNOWLEDGE/BEHAVIORAL/CAPABILITY-GAP) | NONE possible via system-prompt edit space |

No capability clusters exist: not a single task reached the model, so there is zero
capability signal (no reward-0-with-output, no partial-credit, no communication/omission).

## Changes made this iteration
None. No edit to `prompt.md` passes REAL+SAFE+VERIFIED, because there is no capability
failure to target and no prompt text can affect a `temperature` 400.

## Verify-the-fix
- N/A — no edit shipped. Verification instead DISPROVED the viability of any prompt edit:
  the error occurs at request validation on the `temperature` field, so identical text
  or any rewritten text yields the identical 400. Confirmed 50/50 traces have `tokens=«redacted»
  and `tool_calls=[]`, i.e. the prompt was never evaluated.

## Required fix (OUT OF SCOPE for this capability — for the harness owner)
The rollout/LLM-client config must stop sending `temperature: 0.0` to `azure/gpt-5.5`.
Options: (a) set `temperature=1` (the only supported value) or omit the parameter so the
API default applies; (b) special-case gpt-5.5 in the temperature-setting code; (c) add a
model-group fallback. Until then EVERY candidate (baseline included) scores 0.000 and the
hill-climb cannot make progress — the loop is config-blocked, not prompt-blocked.

## Process & features used
- Serial diagnosis (read-only): enumerated all 50 trajectories, grepped error signatures,
  confirmed 0 tool_calls / 0 tokens on every one. No subagents/worktrees needed — the
  signal was uniform and required no fan-out.
- Prior iterations read: none exist (this is the seed baseline; RUNMAP/LEDGER empty).

## Good things to PRESERVE
- `prompt.md` is left byte-for-byte unchanged. It is a reasonable SpreadsheetBench policy
  (cell/sheet-level scoping, literal values over live formulas, save-to-output_path,
  fix-on-traceback). Do NOT churn it while the run is infra-blocked — a future iteration
  can only get real signal AFTER the temperature config is fixed.

## Deliberately skipped
- ALL 50 tasks: uncontrollable infrastructure error (temperature 400). The instructions
  explicitly list these as infra noise ("no edit can fix them, do not change anything on
  their account"). Editing on their account would be speculative and unverifiable.
